correctness.rationale: Any k-linear associative derivation of M_n(k) is inner ad_A, modulo scalar matrices. For odd characteristic idempotent ad_A has all eigenvalue differences in {0,1} and their negatives, so is zero. In characteristic 2, (ad_A)^2=ad_A iff A²+A=cI. Artin–Schreier trace zero gives idempotent split A up to scalar shift; trace one gives irreducible quadratic class over F_(q²) only for n even. Rank-r split operators counted by [n choose r]_q q^{r(n-r)}/(1+1_(2r=n)), nonsplit by GL_n(q)/(2 GL_(n/2)(q²)). The commutation of idempotent ad_A,ad_B forces [A,B]=λI and 0=[A²+A,B]=λI, so actual A,B commute; for each A, its split block centralizer yields (I_r I_s+J_r J_s)/2 neighbors, nonsplit centralizer gives I_(n/2)(q²), zero gives all P_n. The weighted sum gives all ordered commuting pairs; sample (n,q)=(4,2) yields 457 operators and 18169 ordered pairs. Finite fields with extension q are included, n>=2.
